“原子”表示某个操作在并发观察下不可被拆成一半看到。
例如一个原子自增不会出现另一个线程只看到“读取完成但写回还没完成”的中间状态。
f8047c5493232cf4a65c6d2a7984735c334b4a8a.translatedText: "Atomic" means that a certain operation cannot be observed as split in half under concurrent observation\. For example, with an atomic increment, another thread will not see an intermediate state where "the read has completed but the write\-back has not yet completed\."
